title: $\mu$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present $\mu$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $\mu$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $\mu$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23\mu$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. translated_title: $\mu$MPC：通过Koopman线性化预编译实现从边缘设备到GPU的微秒级非线性与世界模型控制
translated_abstract: 我们提出了$\mu$MPC，一个利用学习到的Koopman线性化动力学来减少在线计算量的快速模型预测控制（MPC）框架。通过预计算有限时域的控制到输出映射，$\mu$MPC消除了提升状态轨迹，得到仅含动作变量的Koopman编译二次规划，其决策变量数为$Hn_u$，与提升维度无关。固定的预计算原始算子使得仅依靠矩阵-向量乘法和投影即可实现高效的原始-对偶迭代，无需重新分解即可适应变化的目标和约束。这种高效率还使得通过训练循环中可微的KC-QP实现控制感知的动力学学习以及批量DAgger式数据聚合成为可能。$\mu$MPC在桌面CPU上实现了低至23微秒的求解时间，在168 MHz的Crazyflie微控制器上实现了24毫秒的求解时间。它可扩展至在5毫秒内完成4096维四足机器人控制、0.4毫秒内完成2048维世界模型的视觉规划等任务。
tldr: 该论文提出$\mu$MPC框架，通过Koopman线性化预编译将非线性模型预测控制转化为仅含动作变量的二次规划，实现了从微控制器到GPU的微秒级高速控制，同时支持控制感知的动力学学习。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes $\mu$MPC, a framework that converts nonlinear model predictive control into an action-only QP via Koopman-linearized precompilation, achieving microsecond-scale high-speed control from microcontrollers to GPUs while supporting control-aware dynamics learning.
